svg.title: AWS Java module architecture
svg.desc: Java SDK v2 helpers expose blocking, CompletableFuture, and suspend APIs while service SDK artifacts stay compileOnly.
svg.text: Java SDK v2 helpers expose blocking, CompletableFuture, and suspend APIs while service SDK artifacts stay compileOnly.
adds only the AWS SDK services it uses at runtime
thin Kotlin layer over AWS Java SDK v2
core clients are API/runtime; service clients are compileOnly in this module
icons appear only on actual AWS service/resource cards
The module supplies Kotlin-friendly helpers; applications still choose and own concrete AWS SDK service dependencies.
